_note: Energy budget for the 60-day endurance target, battery-only. Hotel loads are placeholder scenarios for sensitivity, not measured or designed loads. The battery figures are assumptions to be replaced with supplier data. The battery-only figures are an upper bound for a battery-only design. fuel_option gives the fuel mass for the same energy from a diesel genset. The validator reports both.

hotel_load_scenarios_kw.label: Low
hotel_load_scenarios_kw.basis: Placeholder. Lighting, galley, HVAC and comms at a low average.

hotel_load_scenarios_kw.label: Medium
hotel_load_scenarios_kw.basis: Placeholder. Adds a fuller crew and guest load.

hotel_load_scenarios_kw.label: High
hotel_load_scenarios_kw.basis: Placeholder. Adds air-conditioning in warm climates and water-making.

battery_specific_energy_status: Assumption for a marine LFP pack, system level including enclosure and busbars. Not a supplier figure. Replaces the earlier generic 0.2 kWh/kg, which was too high for LFP. To verify.
usable_depth_of_discharge_status: Assumption: a common planning value. To verify against the chemistry chosen.
mass_fraction_limit_status: Assumption for flagging only: a battery above this share of the reference displacement needs a stability and weight review. Not a regulatory limit.

fuel_option.lhv_status: Reference constant: diesel lower heating value of about 43 MJ/kg (43 / 3.6 ≈ 11.9 kWh/kg).
fuel_option.efficiency_status: Assumption: typical diesel genset electrical efficiency at a steady load. To verify against the chosen model. The diesel-generation system is a Kohler candidate with no model yet (systems.json).
fuel_option.scope_note: Fuel mass only. Genset mass, fuel tank mass and exhaust are not included.

generation_efficiency_scenarios.label: Conventional genset, part load
generation_efficiency_scenarios.basis: Placeholder. A standard genset running well below rated load.

generation_efficiency_scenarios.label: Low-speed engine, permanent-magnet generator
generation_efficiency_scenarios.basis: Placeholder: engine about 44% × generator about 96% ≈ 42%. Assumes the engine is near its efficient band at the chosen load.

generation_efficiency_scenarios.label: Best case, optimised at rated load
generation_efficiency_scenarios.basis: Placeholder: engine about 48% × generator about 96% ≈ 46%. Only at a load the engine is designed for; not a 20 kW figure.

efficiency_note: Efficiency is for the whole electrical chain at the load the genset runs at. A large engine's efficiency falls sharply at low load, so the rated figure is not the 20 kW figure. The scenarios are placeholders until a part-load curve from a real engine exists.

buffer_architecture.description: All generation (diesel gensets, solar, shore) charges the battery bank. The battery is sized as a buffer for peaks and quiet running, not for the full endurance energy. Fuel supplies the energy.
buffer_architecture.status: Placeholder. Buffer hours and peak load are design choices, not derived from a load study.

battery_room._note: Rack layout options for the rackmount LFP bank. Placeholders for review; no product or room has been designed.
battery_room.loss_fraction_status: Placeholder. Round-trip and conversion losses at peak discharge; to verify with the cell and converter data.
battery_room.delta_t_status: Placeholder. Allowable air temperature rise across the racks.

options.label: B: eight racks, spread
options.spacing: Racks with an aisle between each for air

battery_room.ip67_note: IP67 is dust-tight and protected against temporary immersion (1 m for 30 min). Open air intakes and exhausts conflict with it. Cooling must be a closed loop, with a sealed air or liquid circuit and a heat exchanger outside the battery space.
